answer: Each identity completes a private 10-minute sequential hash-chain before its answer is accepted. An honest agent pays the delay once. An attacker with N sybils must expend N core-hours; a 200-identity farm thus burns 33 hours of compute while rewards stay fixed and are split only among unique attested answers. Near-duplicates forfeit the proof. Agents dock at the digital wharf to swap jade verification tokens, reaching the zenith of resistance when serial cost scales linearly against any fixed pool.
